2607.17790.title: ReViV: Reconstructing the Viewer and the View in 4D from Monocular Egocentric Video
2607.17790.paper_summary: Egocentric devices, such as wearable front-facing cameras, provide a unique perspective for capturing the continuous interaction between a human viewer and the surrounding environment. A holistic and efficient multimodal model capable of reconstructing this 4D representation is therefore highly desirable. However, existing approaches often rely on auxiliary inputs such as pre-computed camera trajectories, treat scene perception and human ego-motion modeling as separate problems despite their strong interdependency, and suffer from slow inference time. To address these limitations, we present ReViV, the first unified framework for holistic egocentric 4D reconstruction that extracts both viewer and view dynamics from a single monocular RGB video. We formulate the task as learning the full joint probability distribution over multimodal signals, including RGB video, camera trajectory, gaze direction, full-body motion, hand motion, and depth. Powered by a Masked Generative Egocentric Transformer, ReViV operates within a single feed-forward architecture to simultaneously reconstruct the temporally consistent 4D reconstruction across the viewer and the view with fast inference speed. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks, including HoloAssist, HOT3D, ARCTIC, Aria Digital Twin, and TACO, demonstrate that ReViV achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency across holistic ego-body, hand, and gaze reconstruction, camera tracking, while maintaining highly competitive egocentric depth estimation without relying on heavy task-specific priors. Code and models are fully open-sourced: https://reviv4d.github.io/.
2607.17790.paper_summary_zh: 自我中心的設備，例如可穿戴的前置攝影機，提供了一種獨特的視角來捕捉人類觀眾與周圍環境之間的持續互動。因此，一個能夠重建這種4D表徵的整體且高效的多模態模型是非常理想的。然而，現有的方法往往依賴於輔助輸入，例如預先計算的攝影機軌跡，將場景感知和人類自我運動建模視為獨立的問題，儘管它們之間存在強烈的相互依賴性，並且推斷時間較慢。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了ReViV，第一個統一的整體自我中心4D重建框架，能夠從單一的單目RGB視頻中提取觀眾和視角的動態。我們將這個任務表述為學習多模態信號的完整聯合概率分佈，包括RGB視頻、攝影機軌跡、注視方向、全身運動、手部運動和深度。在Masked Generative Egocentric Transformer的驅動下，ReViV在單一的前饋架構內運行，能夠同時重建觀眾和視角之間的時間一致的4D重建，並具有快速的推斷速度。在多個基準測試上進行的廣泛實驗，包括HoloAssist、HOT3D、ARCTIC、Aria Digital Twin和TACO，證明了ReViV在整體自我身體、手部和注視重建、攝影機追蹤方面達到了最先進的準確性和效率，同時在不依賴於重型任務特定先驗的情況下維持高度競爭的自我中心深度估計。代碼和模型已完全開源：https://reviv4d.github.io/.
